tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Start here to discover Patch actions, granted permissions, feature prerequisites and the next tools to call.

tools.name: place_call
tools.description: Place one real phone call FROM the selected outbound number (the authenticated user’s verified personal number by default) to accomplish a specific objective (book a table, ask a question, chase an order). A real-time voice agent handles the call, including automated phone menus and hold queues. Its

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get the status and, once terminal, the structured resolution of a call started with place_call. Returns instantly by default. Pass wait_seconds (max 50) to have the server hold the request and return early on any status change — fewer round trips while a call is in progress. Terminal statuses: compl

tools.name: set_call_visibility
tools.description: Make a call owned by the authenticated user public or private. Calls are private by default. Only publish when the user explicitly asks: a public call exposes its objective, phone numbers, transcript, result and audio to anyone with its permanent, token-free listen_url, including live audio while in

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End an in-progress call early. Patch requests disconnection by deleting the LiveKit room; a spoken farewell is not guaranteed. Check get_call for the resulting status. Use when the user changes their mind or the call is no longer needed. Available transcript snapshots are retained and the resolution

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List this account's phone numbers, active direction availability and default_number_id. Use number_id to select a source for place_call. Accepts calls:read or numbers:read; management settings and workspace_revision are included only with numbers:read. Does not expose agent instructions or voices.

tools.name: get_phone_number
tools.description: Read one owned number by number_id; omit it to inspect the default outbound number. Accepts calls:read or numbers:read. Number-management settings, revision, recovery deadline and workspace_revision require numbers:read. Does not place a call or expose agent instructions or voices.

tools.name: list_activity
tools.description: Read owned history newest first. kind=call (default) requires calls:read and returns call statuses, resolution summaries/outcomes and listen links. kind=test requires configuration:read and returns finished synthetic tests. kind=all requires both permissions. Pass next_cursor unchanged with the same

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read your profile, caller verification, revision, account defaults, setup progress and notices. Use update_account for profile changes and set_onboarding for setup state.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update supplied profile, language and voice defaults using the revision from get_account. Language and voice defaults require configuration permission. Internal system prompts are not exposed through MCP.

tools.name: set_onboarding
tools.description: Save only setup progress: choose inbound/outbound intent and mark the checklist checkout, complete or skipped. Checkout records progress only; this tool never opens payment, buys a plan or acquires a number.

tools.name: list_authorized_apps
tools.description: List applications authorized to access this account. These are distinct from external tools used by voice agents.

tools.name: revoke_authorized_app
tools.description: Disconnect an authorized application. Revoking the current application ends this MCP connection.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Find the identifiers and revisions of your inbound and outbound agents.

tools.name: search_phone_numbers
tools.description: Search currently available US or Canadian numbers by area code. Offers expire; claim an exact returned offer.

tools.name: claim_phone_number
tools.description: Acquire an offered number using your plan allowance. Reuse request_id after an interrupted response.

tools.name: get_number_claim
tools.description: Read provisioning progress for a number claim.

tools.name: update_phone_number
tools.description: Change a label, inbound/outbound availability or retention preference using the number revision.

tools.name: set_default_phone_number
tools.description: Choose the default outbound number using workspace_revision from get_phone_number.

tools.name: get_forwarding_carrier
tools.description: Suggest forwarding instructions for the verified personal number during inbound onboarding. Carrier lookups are cached for a day.

tools.name: get_forwarding_instructions
tools.description: Get carrier-specific steps for forwarding an existing phone to an owned Patch number. The user or carrier must activate forwarding; Patch cannot activate it remotely.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Read active user-configurable settings and revision. Inbound includes editable greeting/instructions; outbound prompt text and Patch internal system prompts are not exposed. Settings are null until configured.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Apply supplied settings directly to an agent for future calls using the revision from get_agent. Inbound greeting and instructions are editable. Outbound greeting and system instructions are not exposed or editable through MCP; supply per-call facts in place_call objective and context. Use set_agent

tools.name: reset_agent
tools.description: Reset user-configurable agent settings to defaults for future calls. Removes active external connection assignments and requires connector permission when assignments exist.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List supported languages, built-in voices with preview URLs, owned voice clones and your clone limit.

tools.name: get_voice_preview
tools.description: Get a short-lived playable URL using provider_voice_id from list_voices, or Claudia's provider ID. Use the provider identity here; clone management uses voice_id. Built-in catalog voices already include sample URLs.

tools.name: create_voice_upload
tools.description: Create an expiring audio upload URL. PUT the file bytes there, then call create_voice with the upload_id and the user’s own-voice consent.

tools.name: create_voice
tools.description: Clone an uploaded sample of the user’s own voice. consent must represent the user’s explicit permission; never infer consent.

tools.name: rename_voice
tools.description: Rename one of your voice clones.

tools.name: delete_voice
tools.description: Delete your voice clone and its provider samples. A voice in an active call cannot be deleted.

tools.name: verify_voice
tools.description: Refresh provider verification status. If verification is still required, the user must complete the provider’s verification with support.

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: Read this account's saved voice-agent connections, authorization state and common providers. Returns setup_url for entering API keys or custom OAuth credentials on the website. Reads stored metadata only; does not contact providers, discover tools, assign agents or invoke external actions.

tools.name: get_connector_tools
tools.description: Read the cached individual tool definitions for an owned connection. These functions are exposed separately to the voice agent on calls after set_agent_connectors assigns the connection. This read does not invoke them, refresh discovery or return credentials.

tools.name: create_connector
tools.description: Save a hosted voice-agent MCP connection requiring no credentials or standard browser OAuth, without contacting it or assigning agents. Never ask for or submit API keys, tokens, client secrets or credential-bearing URLs in chat. For API-key or custom OAuth setup, send the user to setup_url from list

tools.name: connect_connector
tools.description: Contact an owned connection to discover or refresh its individual voice-agent tools. May begin third-party OAuth and return authorization_url for the user to approve; never collect verification codes or credentials in chat. Does not invoke external tools or change agent assignments. Inspect get_conn

tools.name: add_common_connector
tools.description: Create or return a managed Exa web-search connection using this account's existing paid entitlement. New connections are unassigned. Does not subscribe, charge, search, discover tools or change assignments. Next use connect_connector, inspect get_connector_tools and explicitly set_agent_connectors.

tools.name: set_agent_connectors
tools.description: Replace the external connections available to one active voice agent for future calls. Review get_connector_tools and obtain authorization for those capabilities first. Every discovered function is exposed individually to the voice agent; it may invoke those external actions within its call instruct

tools.name: remove_connector
tools.description: Delete an owned connection and its saved credentials. Also revoke that connection from every assigned agent without applying unrelated settings. Requires configuration permission when an agent assignment is removed. Does not invoke external tools or revoke consent at the third-party provider.

tools.name: list_test_scenarios
tools.description: List synthetic test scenarios and available responder outcomes. Tests use fictional data and never invoke connected external tools.

tools.name: start_agent_test
tools.description: Run one isolated synthetic conversation against the active agent settings at the supplied revision. Outbound supports preset or custom fictional scenarios; inbound requires custom_scenario. Uses LiveKit test rooms and may consume AI usage. Never dials a phone number, publishes settings or invokes co

tools.name: get_agent_test
tools.description: Read a synthetic test’s status, transcript, result and transcript expiry.

tools.name: get_agent_test_listener
tools.description: Get a short-lived, subscribe-only LiveKit credential for listening to your running synthetic test from a compatible client.

tools.name: stop_agent_test
tools.description: Stop your synthetic test and retain its captured result.

tools.name: get_call_diagnostics
tools.description: Read private diagnostic events for an owned call. Public call visibility never grants access to diagnostics.

tools.name: get_call_listener
tools.description: Get a short-lived, subscribe-only LiveKit credential for listening to your active call from a compatible client.

tools.name: resume_operation
tools.description: Recover an interrupted number claim, voice clone or subscription attempt owned by this account and the original authorization grant. Requires that operation's original permissions. May reconcile number provisioning, find the exact existing provider voice, or retry the persisted subscription request

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Recover a request’s durable outcome. A running/needs_attention operation must not be retried under a new ID.

tools.name: get_billing
tools.description: Read plans, usage, subscription state, payment-method summary and invoices. Reconciles subscription state with Stripe; use invoice_cursor for older invoices.

tools.name: preview_subscription_change
tools.description: Create a 15-minute quote for starting a subscription, changing its plan, canceling renewal at period end, or undoing cancellation/a scheduled downgrade. Returns immediate charges, monthly list price, effective time and allowances. May read Stripe and save a local quote; does not charge or change a s

tools.name: execute_subscription_change
tools.description: Apply the exact, unexpired quote the user explicitly approved after seeing its immediate charges, recurring price, effective time and limits. May charge a saved payment method, change the subscription, cancel renewal or undo a scheduled change. Set user_authorized=true only after that approval; neve

tools.name: update_billing_profile
tools.description: Update the Stripe customer’s billing name, email or address. Payment credentials are never accepted here.

tools.name: create_billing_portal
tools.description: Create a Stripe-hosted billing portal link for this account's existing Stripe customer. Creating the link does not charge, change or cancel a subscription; the user chooses and confirms any billing changes on Stripe. Returns to Patch's fixed billing page. Reuse request_id after a lost response. Neve

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: place_call, get_call, end_call, list_voices, get_voice_preview, set_agent_connectors, get_agent_test · Private data: place_call, get_call, set_call_visibility, set_onboarding, create_voice_upload, list_connectors, get_connector_tools, create_connector, connect_connector, remove_connector, get_agent_test_listener, get_call_diagnostics, get_call_listener, execute_subscription_change, update_billing_profile · Public sink: get_call, set_call_visibility, create_voice_upload, create_connector, update_billing_profile · Destructive: reset_agent, delete_voice, remove_connector, start_agent_test, execute_subscription_change.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: place_call, get_call, end_call, list_voices, get_voice_preview, set_agent_connectors, get_agent_test · Private data: place_call, get_call, set_call_visibility, set_onboarding, create_voice_upload, list_connectors, get_connector_tools, create_connector, connect_connector, remove_connector, get_agent_test_listener, get_call_diagnostics, get_call_listener, execute_subscription_change, update_billing_profile · Public sink: get_call, set_call_visibility, create_voice_upload, create_connector, update_billing_profile · Destructive: reset_agent, delete_voice, remove_connector, start_agent_test, execute_subscription_change

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

evidence.snippet: before: "Preview subscribing, upgrading/downgrading, canceling at period end or resuming. Show charges and limits to the user before execution." → after: "Create a 15-minute quote for starting a subscription, changing its plan, canceling renewal at period end, or undoing cancellation/a scheduled downgrade. Returns immediate charges, monthly list price, effective time and allowances. May read Stripe and save a local quote; does not charge or change a s"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

evidence.snippet: before: "Execute an authorized quote. May charge a saved payment method. Use the same request_id after a lost response; return a direct payment/authentication link when interaction is required." → after: "Apply the exact, unexpired quote the user explicitly approved after seeing its immediate charges, recurring price, effective time and limits. May charge a saved payment method, change the subscription, cancel renewal or undo a scheduled change. Set user_authorized=true only after that approval; neve"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a direct Stripe portal session to securely update payment methods or finish a billing action requiring a person. Never ask the user to paste card details into chat." → after: "Create a Stripe-hosted billing portal link for this account's existing Stripe customer. Creating the link does not charge, change or cancel a subscription; the user chooses and confirms any billing changes on Stripe. Returns to Patch's fixed billing page. Reuse request_id after a lost response. Neve"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
